description: List changed file paths in a merge request without diff content (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). Read-only; missing resources, denied access, and rate limits return errors. `project_id`/`group_id` take a numeric ID or URL-encoded path.

excluded_file_patterns.description: Array of regex patterns to exclude files. Examples: ["^vendor/", "\.pb\.go$"]

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project

name: list_merge_request_changed_files
